title: Compact distance sublevel sets around a compact subset of an open set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let C ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and nonempty with C ⊆ U. Then there is δ₀ > 0 such that for every real r ≤ δ₀ the sublevel set {x ∈ ℝ^P : dist(x, C) ≤ r} of the distance function dist(x, C) = Metric.infDist x C is compact and contained in U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U C : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → C.Nonempty → ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, r ≤ δ₀ → IsCompact {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ∧ {x | infDist x C ≤ r} ⊆ U
